messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "mix with apple sauce"
set: ["mix with apple sauce", "mix with apple juice", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "mix with infant formula", "if giving through a nasogastric (ng) or gastrostomy tube, mix only with apple juice", "must mix powder with water", "mix the medicine with soft food", "mix with an undesirable, nontoxic substance", "do not mix with any other liquid", "mix capsule with water or infant formula only", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk", "mix tablet with 1 or 2 teaspoons of water", "mix granules with applesauce, mashed carrots, rice, or ice cream", "mix with water if child prescribed tablets for oral suspension", "do not mix with soy-based infant formula or other foods", "do not mix in advance"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
